subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Certainty
solution:
The correct answer is **doubt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Certainty: **the state of being completely sure about something.
 
• **Doubt: **a feeling of uncertainty.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate **antonym** of the given word is given in **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unreasonable: **unfair; expecting too much.
 
• **Prolong: **to make something last longer.
 
• **Divulge: **to tell something that is secret.
